title.narrative: SALAR Scoping Mission: Support local governance in Georgia
SALAR Scoping Mission: Support local governance in Georgia

description.narrative:
SALAR International AB (hereafter SALAR), a fully owned subsidiary of the Swedish Association of Local Authorities and Regions (hereafter SKR) contacted the Embassy of Sweden in 2020, regarding a potential Swedish support to the local governments and the decentralisation reform in Georgia. In 2022, SALAR approached the Embassy again, with a request to support a scoping mission that foresees to meet with relevant actors in Georgia and determine the ways forward.
The objectives of the scoping mission are:
- To provide a situational overview of the evolving needs of the local governments and deepen the understanding related to the decentralisation reform in Georgia, and identify where Swedish support through SALAR can have an added value.
- To investigate further, the thematic entry points of relevance and how a programme supporting local governments processes could be designed and developed.
As a result of the scoping mission, SALAR plans to outline an Inception phase for future project/programme support.
SALAR will conduct scoping mission to Georgia in order to prepare possible contribution in support local governance in Georgia
